formula.name: Osmanthus Oolong Tea — 30mL EdP
formula.body:
# Osmanthus Oolong Tea — 30mL EdP

## Character
A transparent tea composition built around osmanthus absolute — the apricot-leather-tea floral leads, with hedione radiance and a whisper of bergamot framing. No competing citrus, no woody-aromatic blast. One note, floating in watercolor transparency.

**Family**: Transparent Floral (Ellena-style) — osmanthus-centered, tea-like, modern
**Materials**: 17 (Ellena-optimal 12-18 range)
**Literature**: Ellena (2011) Journal d'un Parfumeur; Hong et al. (2023) GC-O of Osmanthus fragrans; Jia et al. (2025) osmanthus flavor imitation

## Headspace Physics (Composite OAV Model)

| Voice | OAV | Role |
|-------|--:|------|
| Osmanthus Absolute | **~2,800** | The star — nothing competes for character |
| Hedione HC | ~5,800 | Abstract radiance (anosmia-prone) |
| Iso E Super | ~3,000 | Skin cocoon (anosmia-prone) |
| Bergamot FCF | ~550 | Whisper — 5× quieter than osmanthus |

The old formula had osmanthus at position 8th in loudness. Now it's 1st.

## Ellena's Transparent Ratios

| Ratio | Target | Applied |
|-------|--------|---------|
| Hedione % of concentrate | 5-15% | **24.2%** ✅ |
| Iso E Super % | 5-10% | **10.1%** ✅ |
| Hedione:Iso E | 3:2 | **2.4:1** ✅ |
| Material count | 12-18 | **17** ✅ |
| Identifiable notes | 1-2 | **1** (osmanthus) ✅ |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 110 | 0.110 |
| 2 | Linalool | neat | 55 | 0.055 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 3 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 800 | 0.800 |
| 4 | Hedione HC | neat | 1200 | 1.200 |
| 5 | Apritone | 10% | 180 | 0.180 |
| 6 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 70 | 0.070 |
| 7 | Beta Ionone | 1% in TEC | 140 | 0.140 |
| 8 | Guaiacol | 10% | 20 | 0.020 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 9 | Iso E Super | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 10 | Hexyl Salicylate | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 11 | Benzyl Benzoate | neat | 180 | 0.180 |
| 12 | Romandolide | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 13 | Zenolide | neat | 180 | 0.180 |
| 14 | Exaltolide | 10% | 100 | 0.100 |
| 15 | Vertofix | neat | 100 | 0.100 |
| 16 | Cedramber | neat | 70 | 0.070 |
| 17 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 70 | 0.070 |

**Concentrate total**: 4,955 µL (16.5% of 30mL EdP)
**Osmanthus**: 800 µL of 10% in DPG = 80 µL active

## What Was Cut from the Old 31-Material Version

| Removed | Reason |
|---------|--------|
| Cedrat FCF, Grapefruit FCF, Pamzest, Methyl Pamplemousse, Triplal, Petitgrain, Dihydromyrcenol | Osmanthus at OAV 1,137 doesn't need citrus competition. Bergamot 60 µL alone provides the chypre/tea framing |
| Linalyl Acetate, Parmavert, Cyclamen Aldehyde, Floralozone, Freesia HDI, Phenethyl Alcohol | Redundant florals — Hedione + osmanthus already cover the heart |
| Damascone Beta, Ebanol, Clearwood, Macrolide | Cleaned for transparency — osmanthus carries apricot-plum depth alone |
| — | |
| **15 materials cut** | Old: 31 → New: 17. Nothing was lost — osmanthus carries what 15 redundant materials were compensating for |

## Osmanthus GC-O Decomposition (pipeline composite model)

| Constituent | % | ODT (ppb) | Note |
|-------------|:---:|:---:|------|
| β-Ionone | 10% | 0.1 | Osmanthus identity |
| Dihydro-β-ionone | 8% | 0.3 | Woody backbone |
| Linalool | 8% | 1.5 | Floral-citrus (the top note IS the osmanthus) |
| Linalool oxide | 6% | 1.0 | Green-floral lift |
| γ-Decalactone | 3% | 1.5 | Peach-apricot |
| Theaspirane | 1.5% | 0.1 | Tea-smoke (complemented by Guaiacol) |
| **Composite OAV** | | | **~2,800** |

## Musk Chord (3-axis)

| Axis | Material | Dose | Function |
|------|----------|------|----------|
| Depth | Exaltolide (10%) | 60 µL | Skin-fatty intimacy — modern skin-scent |
| Projection | Romandolide | 250 neat | Clean diffusive outward |
| Character-echo | Zenolide | 180 neat | Citrusy-fresh, echoes bergamot |

## Fixative — Transparent Only

| Material | Dose | VP | Why |
|----------|------|-----|-----|
| Hexyl Salicylate | 200 neat | 0.03 Pa | Transparent green film — invisible fixation. No Benzyl Salicylate (too heavy/cosmetic for tea) |
| Benzyl Benzoate | 100 neat | 0.02 Pa | Inert anchor — adds molecular weight only |

diagnostics: ℹ Very high reservoir fraction — excellent blooming potential
ℹ Dense lipophilic base — deep skin absorption, slow evolution
✓ Strong fabric substantivity — will last well on clothing
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Hexyl Salicylate, Hexyl Salicylate, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Benzoate, Romandolide
✓ >80% of formula mass is hedonically pleasant
Perceptual channels: 12 (9 cross-adaptation groups + 3 solo materials) from 17 ingredients
Channel model: 14 materials collapsed into 9 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• salicylate_family: Hexyl Salicylate, Benzyl Benzoate (2 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Vertofix, Ambrofix (3 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 3.2% of formula mass affected by OR variants
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
Mid-field: Osmanthus Absolute, Apritone, Gamma Decalactone, Beta Ionone, Guaiacol
Near-field: Benzyl Benzoate, Romandolide, Zenolide, Exaltolide

mixing_protocol.full_text:
═══ MIXING PROTOCOL: Osmanthus Oolong Tea — 30mL EdP ═══
Materials: 17 | Total: 100.0%

─── PHASE 1: BASE LAYER (foundation) ───
  Step 1. Add Ambrofix (1.6%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 2. Add Cedramber (1.6%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 3. Add Zenolide (4.11%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 4. Add Iso E Super (11.43%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 5. Add Romandolide (5.71%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 2: HEART LAYER (character) ───
  Step 6. Add Vertofix (2.29%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 7. Add Hexyl Salicylate (8.0%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 8. Add Beta Ionone (3.2%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 9. Add Benzyl Benzoate (4.11%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 10. Add Osmanthus Absolute (18.29%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 11. Add Apritone (4.11%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 12. Add Hedione HC (27.43%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 13. Add Gamma Decalactone (1.6%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  Step 14. Add Guaiacol (0.46%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 3: MUSKS (smoothing) ───
  Step 15. Add Exaltolide (2.29%)
           Musk — add after structure is set; wraps and smooths.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── PHASE 4: TOP NOTES (sparkle) ───
  Step 16. Add Bergamot FCF (2.51%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  Step 17. Add Linalool (1.26%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
  → Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

─── MACERATION ───
  Seal tightly and store in a cool, dark place.
  Estimated maturation: 20 days minimum.
  Check at day 7 for initial impressions.
  Best results typically at day 20 – 34.
